name: foam-rolling-pecs
instructions:
1. In a prone position, position the foam roller near your armpit on the base of your pec.
2. Support yourself with your free hand and feet.
3. Adjust pressure into the roller by raising your hips higher or lower or applying more force through your free hand into the ground.
4. Slowly roll up and down the length of the pec for 20-30 seconds. This is a fairly small region so there shouldn’t be a large range of motion.
5. Repeat on the other side.
